name: Mosharrof
capability_formula: AI_BRAIN x PERMISSION x POLICY x SCOPE x IDENTITY
principles: Every meaningful component is an Entity.
Every Entity has an explicit responsibility boundary.
Every Entity can use an independent Brain through a model adapter.
Identity, memory, policy, permission, tools, communication and audit are explicit.
The Core coordinates; it does not silently absorb every responsibility.
Model replacement must not erase Entity identity or durable state.
